title: personas deliverable rubric
description: Per-deliverable expert subagent for #personas output. Audits Cooper-goal-hierarchy completeness (life goals + end goals + experience goals), JTBD presence, persona elasticity (age range <=12 years, contradictory behaviors flagged), verbatim quote authenticity (no fabricated quotes), and the 3+ named-external-citation evidence floor per persona per the persona-architect skill.

anchors.5: fully meets the criterion as the five column states
anchors.3: present but partially met or partially traced
anchors.1: absent, fabricated, or as the one column states

criteria.label: Cooper goal hierarchy
criteria.five: Every persona has life goals + end goals + experience goals populated and distinguishable
criteria.one: Goals collapsed into a flat list

criteria.label: JTBD presence
criteria.five: Every persona has an explicit Jobs-To-Be-Done statement (3-5 sentences naming functional + emotional + social dimensions)

criteria.label: Persona-quote authenticity
criteria.five: Every persona-quote is a VERBATIM excerpt from a named source (user-research interview, Reddit comment, forum post), not paraphrased, not generic

criteria.label: Evidence density
criteria.five: ≥3 named external citations per persona; ≥50% citations external (not client uploads)

criteria.label: Persona elasticity (REJECT criteria)
criteria.five: Age ranges ≤12 years (not "25-55"); no contradictory behaviors in same persona; not a "composite of 4 personas in 1"

criteria.label: Demographics-first thinking (REJECT criteria)
criteria.five: Personas built from JTBD + goals + pains; demographics descriptive, not defining

criteria.label: Distinct personas
criteria.five: No 2 personas are near-duplicates (>60% JTBD + pain overlap)

criteria.label: Anti-slop in persona names
criteria.five: No metaphor names ("The Architect", "The Sage"); plain descriptive names ("First-Year Co-op Applicant", "Mid-Career Returner")

criteria.label: Pain point specificity
criteria.five: Each pain point names the SYSTEM, TEAM, or STAKEHOLDER affected + the operational consequence (per constraint feedback_personas_persona_quote in MEMORY)

criteria.label: Image-prompt consistency
criteria.five: If persona-card includes image_prompt, the described persona MATCHES the persona attributes (per memory: persona image gender must match caption pronouns + varied non-cliche scenes)

criteria.label: Cached-selection coverage
criteria.five: ≥80% of the user's KL-curated items appear in the emission as source: cached or source: extended; new items have source: new; coverage is reported as cached_selection_coverage_pct in the verdict
criteria.one: <60% coverage (auto Stop-hook reject via validate_cached_selection_honored.py); model regenerated from scratch and ignored the user's curation

decision.approve: all dimensions ≥3 AND Cooper-goal-hierarchy ≥4 AND persona-quote authenticity = 5 (any fabrication = automatic reject)
decision.revise: 1-2 dimensions below floor; orchestrator regenerates the violator personas only
decision.reject: persona-quote authenticity ≤3 (fabricated quotes) OR persona elasticity violations OR demographics-first thinking

verdict_rule.refine: any criterion scored below its floor
verdict_rule.pass: every scored criterion at or above its floor
